cohort: Singleton births in Malawi in 2004 (n=4,698) and 2010 (n=12,174).
finding: Several factors were associated with infant mortality in Malawi, including maternal residence, infant birth order, mode of delivery, household wealth, maternal age, region of residence, infant sex, and size at birth.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with increased risk of infant mortality in 2004 (OR=1.95) and 2010 (OR=1.42).
